description.en: Mr Tyson counts everything, even Jack's sheep: numbers from one to a hundred, the days and what time it is.
description.sl: Gospod Tyson šteje vse, celo Jackove ovce: števila od ena do sto, dnevi in koliko je ura.
description.it: Il signor Tyson conta tutto, perfino le pecore di Jack: i numeri da uno a cento, i giorni e che ore sono.
description.de: Herr Tyson zählt alles, sogar Jacks Schafe: die Zahlen von eins bis hundert, die Tage und wie spät es ist.

words.example_en: One, two, three … go!
words.example_it: Uno, due, tre… via!
words.note: The old shepherds here counted sheep yan, tyan, tethera: one, two, three.
words.note_sl: Stari pastirji so tu šteli ovce yan, tyan, tethera: ena, dva, tri.
words.note_it: I vecchi pastori di qui contavano le pecore yan, tyan, tethera: uno, due, tre.
words.note_de: Die alten Schäfer hier zählten Schafe yan, tyan, tethera: eins, zwei, drei.

words.example_en: Jack has got two black lambs.
words.example_it: Jack ha due agnellini neri.
words.note: Two, too and to sound the same.
words.note_sl: Two, too (tudi) in to (k, do) se izgovorijo enako.
words.note_it: Two, too (anche) e to (a) si pronunciano uguale.
words.note_de: Two, too (auch) und to (zu) klingen gleich.

words.example_en: Three children are playing by the beck.
words.example_sl: Trije otroci se igrajo ob potoku.
words.example_it: Tre bambini giocano vicino al ruscello.
words.note: For th, put your tongue between your teeth: three, not tree.
words.note_sl: Pri th je jezik med zobmi: three, ne tree (drevo).
words.note_it: Per il th metti la lingua tra i denti: three, non tree (albero).
words.note_de: Beim th liegt die Zunge zwischen den Zähnen: three, nicht tree (Baum).

words.example_en: A sheep has four legs.
words.example_it: La pecora ha quattro zampe.

words.example_en: Alfie can count to five.
words.example_it: Alfie sa contare fino a cinque.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson gets up at six.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson si alza alle sei.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson steht um sechs auf.

words.example_en: A week has seven days.
words.example_it: La settimana ha sette giorni.

words.example_en: School starts at eight.
words.example_it: La scuola comincia alle otto.
words.example_de: Die Schule fängt um acht an.
words.note: The gh is silent: eight sounds like ate.
words.note_sl: Črk gh ne izgovoriš: eight se sliši kot ate.
words.note_it: Il gh è muto: eight suona come ate.
words.note_de: Das gh ist stumm: eight klingt wie ate.

words.example_en: Harry is nine.
words.example_it: Harry ha nove anni.

words.example_en: There are ten eggs in the box.
words.example_it: Nella scatola ci sono dieci uova.
words.example_de: In der Schachtel sind zehn Eier.

words.example_en: There are twenty children at the school.
words.example_it: A scuola ci sono venti bambini.
words.example_de: In der Schule sind zwanzig Kinder.
words.note: -ty makes the tens: twenty, thirty, forty. -teen is for 13 to 19: thirteen, fourteen.
words.note_sl: -ty so desetice: twenty, thirty, forty. -teen je za 13 do 19: thirteen, fourteen.
words.note_it: -ty forma le decine: twenty, thirty, forty. -teen è per i numeri da 13 a 19: thirteen, fourteen.
words.note_de: -ty bildet die Zehner: twenty, thirty, forty. -teen steht für 13 bis 19: thirteen, fourteen.

words.example_en: Jack has got a hundred sheep.
words.example_it: Jack ha cento pecore.
words.note: A hundred or one hundred; no -s after a number: two hundred.
words.note_sl: A hundred ali one hundred; za številom brez -s: two hundred.
words.note_it: A hundred o one hundred; dopo un numero niente -s: two hundred.
words.note_de: A hundred oder one hundred; nach einer Zahl ohne -s: two hundred.

words.example_en: Today is Monday.
words.example_it: Oggi è lunedì.

words.example_en: Tomorrow we're going to Keswick.
words.example_it: Domani andiamo a Keswick.

words.example_en: It rained yesterday. It rains a lot here!
words.example_sl: Včeraj je deževalo. Tukaj veliko dežuje!
words.example_it: Ieri ha piovuto. Qui piove tanto!
words.example_de: Gestern hat es geregnet. Hier regnet es viel!

words.example_en: See you on Monday!
words.example_it: Ci vediamo lunedì!
words.note: Days start with a capital letter and take on: on Monday (not on the Monday).
words.note_sl: Dnevi z veliko začetnico in s predlogom on: on Monday (ne on the Monday).
words.note_it: I giorni con la maiuscola e con on: on Monday (non on the Monday).
words.note_de: Tage großgeschrieben und mit on: on Monday (nicht on the Monday).

words.example_en: On Saturdays there's a market in Keswick.
words.example_sl: Ob sobotah je v Keswicku tržnica.
words.example_it: Il sabato a Keswick c'è il mercato.
words.note_sl: On Saturdays: vsako soboto, ob sobotah.
words.note_it: On Saturdays: ogni sabato, il sabato.

words.example_en: On Sundays Granny Maggie makes sticky toffee pudding.
words.example_sl: Ob nedeljah babica Maggie peče sticky toffee puding.
words.example_it: La domenica nonna Maggie fa lo sticky toffee pudding.
words.example_de: Sonntags macht Oma Maggie Sticky Toffee Pudding.

words.example_en: Auntie Edna knits a tea cosy every week.
words.example_sl: Teta Edna vsak teden splete prevleko za čajnik.
words.example_it: La zia Edna fa un copriteiera a maglia ogni settimana.
words.example_de: Tante Edna strickt jede Woche einen Teewärmer.

words.example_en: It's three o'clock.
words.example_it: Sono le tre in punto.
words.note: Only for full hours: three o'clock, but half past three. It comes from of the clock.
words.note_sl: Samo za polne ure: three o'clock, a half past three. Iz of the clock.
words.note_it: Solo per le ore esatte: three o'clock, ma half past three. Viene da of the clock.
words.note_de: Nur für volle Stunden: three o'clock, aber half past three. Kommt von of the clock.

words.example_en: It's half past three.
words.example_it: Sono le tre e mezza.
words.note: Half an hour after the hour: half past three is 3:30.
words.note_sl: Pozor: half past three je pol štirih (3.30). Angleščina šteje od treh, ne do štirih.
words.note_it: Mezz'ora dopo l'ora: half past three sono le tre e mezza (3.30).
words.note_de: Vorsicht: half past three ist halb vier (3:30). Englisch zählt von drei aus, nicht bis vier.

words.example_en: It's quarter to four. Tea's ready!
words.example_sl: Ura je tri četrt na štiri. Čaj je pripravljen!
words.example_it: Sono le quattro meno un quarto. Il tè è pronto!
words.example_de: Es ist Viertel vor vier. Der Tee ist fertig!
words.note: Fifteen minutes before the hour: quarter to four is 3:45; quarter past four is 4:15.
words.note_sl: Petnajst minut pred polno uro: quarter to four je tri četrt na štiri (3.45); quarter past four je 4.15.
words.note_it: Un quarto d'ora prima dell'ora: quarter to four sono le quattro meno un quarto (3.45); quarter past four le quattro e un quarto.
words.note_de: Eine Viertelstunde vor der vollen Stunde: quarter to four ist Viertel vor vier (3:45); quarter past four ist Viertel nach vier.

words.example_en: Excuse me, what time is it? It's ten o'clock.
words.example_sl: Oprostite, koliko je ura? Ura je deset.
words.example_it: Mi scusi, che ore sono? Sono le dieci.
words.example_de: Entschuldigung, wie spät ist es? Es ist zehn Uhr.
words.note: Also: What's the time? The answer starts with It's: It's ten o'clock.
words.note_sl: Tudi: What's the time? Odgovor se začne z It's: It's ten o'clock.
words.note_it: Anche: What's the time? La risposta comincia con It's: It's ten o'clock.
words.note_de: Auch: What's the time? Die Antwort beginnt mit It's: It's ten o'clock.

words.example_en: How old are you? I'm nine.
words.example_sl: Koliko si star? Star sem devet let.
words.example_it: Quanti anni hai? Ho nove anni.
words.example_de: Wie alt bist du? Ich bin neun.
words.note: With be: I'm nine (years old), never I have nine years.
words.note_sl: Z be: I'm nine (years old), nikoli I have nine years.
words.note_it: Con be, non have: I'm nine (years old), mai I have nine years.
words.note_de: Mit be, wie im Deutschen: I'm nine (years old), ich bin neun.
